title: llama.cpp / vLLM / OpenAI-compatible (embeddings)
description: An embedding model on any server that speaks OpenAI's embeddings API (llama.cpp, vLLM, Text Embeddings Inference, LM Studio), on this machine or your network, as gohort's semantic search: the request and the reply are data you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Start the server with an embedding model (llama.cpp: llama-server --embeddings; vLLM: vllm serve <model> --task embed). The connector takes no key and lands unapproved: approve it in Admin > Extensions > Connectors, run Test on its row (it embeds two short sentences), then pick it under Capabilities > Embeddings. An embedder on this machine or its network waits its turn behind the worker model, as chat does. Many retrieval models want their texts marked (e5: "query: " and "passage: "): set the prefixes under Capabilities > Embeddings. A server that takes a key: add a bearer credential for its address under API Credentials and name it in the spec's auth in place of none. Switching embedders changes the embedding space: run Repair in the Vector Index panel to make stored documents searchable again, which embeds every one of them.

questions.name: base_url
questions.label: Server address
questions.help: The address its /embeddings is under, usually ending in /v1: http://localhost:8080/v1 for llama.cpp, http://localhost:8000/v1 for vLLM.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; the embeddings settings list it by this name.

questions.name: model
questions.label: Model
questions.help: The name the server loaded the model as (vLLM checks it; llama.cpp takes any). The model names the embedding space: changing it later means re-embedding every stored document.
